newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish nurses vote for labour court proposals.
newsitem.headline: Irish nurses vote for labour court proposals.

text.p: A majority of Irish nurses voted in favour of Labour Court proposals on Thursday, Ireland's largest trade union, SIPTU, said in a statement.
"Seventy one percent of our nursing members took part in the ballot," SIPTU National nursing official Noel Dowling said.
He said 74 percent of the votes cast voted in favour of the Labour Court proposals and 26 percent voted against.
"This therefore represents a decisive result in favour of the Labour Court proposals," Dowling said.
Irish nurses threatened nationwide strike action last month. The strike over nurses pay was postponed pending the outcome of this afternoon's ballot.
